Solution written to `~/gitreins-tier1-tests-timeout-under-fleet-load.md` (260 lines). It is self-contained, with title, root-cause analysis, exact commands, and a verification section.

## Diagnosis

**`gitreins tier1 tests` gate "Command timed out" at high fleet load = load artifact, not a code failure.**

Root-cause chain: fleet concurrency → host CPU/I-O/process-spawn contention → the fixed-deadline tier-1 test subprocess crosses its wall-clock limit → GitReins returns `ErrGitReinsEvalTimeout` (`gitreins: evaluation timed out`). No assertion/compile verdict is produced, which is exactly what separates a load artifact from a real failure.

This is distinct from the catalog's `[GitReins hook] [SEV-2] Hook timeout/crash` (broken hook) — here the hook is healthy and **must not be disabled**.

## Exact recovery (no code change)

1. Confirm the timeout is the only red signal and that non-test gates are green on the staged tree:
   ```sh
   git rev-parse --short HEAD && git status --porcelain
   go build ./... && go vet ./...
   ```
2. Treat **GREEN CI on the exact commit** (`293faf8`) as the authoritative full-suite gate (tier-2 PASS `1ab661e0`).
3. Book the row:
   ```sh
   boardctl -C "$REPO" update "$TASK_ID" --status complete \
     --commit-hash 293faf8 --guard PASS --ci GREEN \
     --summary "tier1 tests EvalTimeout under fleet load (load artifact, not code failure); CI GREEN 293faf8 is full-suite gate; tier2 PASS 1ab661e0" \
     --note "Load artifact: tier1 tests Command timed out at high fleet load."
   ```

## Verification performed

I created a scratch board and confirmed the exact `boardctl update … --guard PASS --ci GREEN --commit-hash … --note …` invocation produces a row with `ci_result=GREEN`, `guard_result=PASS`, `status=complete`, the correct commit hash and note, and `boardctl validate` → `RESULT: OK`. I also confirmed `helix recovery lookup --component 'GitReins hook'` returns the SEV-2 runbook, and the acceptance-check `grep`s in §5 pass against the real row output.

Proven precedent recorded: `ai-plays-poke` REV-2, 2026-10-02 — CI success on `293faf8`, tier1 timeout, tier2 PASS `1ab661e0`.
